en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, fom Ali Bin Al Hakam, fom Aban Bin Usman, from Sabbah Bin Sayaba, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

‘Whichever Momin or Muslim dies and leaves debts which do not happen to be regarding corruption or extravagance, so it is upon the Imamasws that heasws fulfils it. Therefore, if heasws does not fulfil it, the sin of that would be upon himasws.
Allahazwj Blessed and High is Saying [9:60] But rather, the charities are only for the poor and the needy – the Verse.
So he is from the debtors, and for him would be a share with the Imam<sup>asws</sup>, and if he<sup>asws</sup> were to withhold it, so its sin would be upon him<sup>asws</sup>’.
